summary: Respawns the player at the last checkpoint when Health fires death, and resets health.
overview: Drop it on the player alongside Health. Call SetCheckpoint when they reach one — typically from a trigger relay — and it respawns them there and resets health when death fires. No death-handling code at the call site.
useCases: Checkpoint respawning in a platformer or action game.
Returning to a safe spot after falling out of the world.
A delay before respawn so a death animation can play.

params.tuning: Time for a death animation or screen effect. Zero makes death feel like a teleport.

gotchas.title: With no checkpoint set, it respawns at the start position
gotchas.body: So a player who dies before reaching the first checkpoint goes back to where they began, which is usually right but worth knowing.
